title: Forecast accuracy on Opportunity
transcript:
Consultant: Walk me through how the team forecasts today.
Client: Honestly it is guesswork. Reps enter the deal but half of them leave
the close date blank, so the pipeline report is meaningless past this month.
Consultant: So close date is optional right now?
Client: It is optional and it should not be. The close date on the
opportunity must be required before anyone can save the record.
Consultant: Understood. Anything about the format?
Client: No, a normal date is fine. We just need it filled in.

expected.note: Client states plainly that close date must be required on Opportunity.
